title: Roman Gods

source.author: Unknown compiler
source.canon: As recorded in the GEDCOM file
source.covers: 322 people and 165 families, imported from a public GEDCOM sample.

notes: Imported from Roman+Gods.ged (Windows-1252; FTM Family Tree Maker (17.0.0.440); file dated 19 November 2007) by scripts/gedcom-to-saga.mts.
Names are read in mythology mode: the deity's name is the GEDCOM surname part, and descriptive text in the given-name part (e.g. "queen of the Gods") is dropped.
Everyone is in one house, "Roman pantheon": the file has no real surnames to group by.
2 people have no recorded relatives in the source and are shown on their own: Honos, Virtus.
